crossRefs.note: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits…
He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;
Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one…
There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits…
He measured the court, one hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

translations.web: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
translations.bsb: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured the distance from gateway to gateway toward the south to be a hundred cubits.
translations.kjv: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
translations.asv: And there was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.
